name: nRF9151 DK (PCA10171)
description: Cellular IoT dev kit: LTE-M, NB-IoT, DECT NR+ and GNSS from the nRF9151 SiP, with J-Link OB debugger, Arduino Uno R3 headers, nano-SIM/eSIM footprints and preloaded SIM cards.
notes: Ships with Onomondo and Wireless Logic SIM cards preloaded with free data (promotion terms may change). Has LTE-M/NB-IoT and GNSS antennas; an SMA-connector variant (NRF9151-SMA-DK) costs about $120-165.
The radio is part of the nRF9151 SiP, so there are no extra radios. The DK's GPIO logic level is switchable (1.8 V / 3 V class); 3.3 is recorded as the closest schema value.
Includes a PCAL6408A I/O expander on I2C. Distributor price about $92-102; $99 is the Symmetry/Avnet/Newark list price. USB connector type, size and GPIO count were not verified.
